The code requirement mandates that all clearance measurements be taken from the outside conductor, not from utility pole centerlines or structures. The complete absence of clearance dimensions prevents assessment of whether any dimensions that might exist are measured correctly.

flagged.comment: Electric easements (5' and 15' marked on site plan) are shown on the site plan. The code absolutely prohibits installing customer facilities under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities, independent of clearance distances. Additionally, items within electric easements must maintain minimum 7.5-foot clearance from outside conductor. Without detailed easement boundary documentation and clearance dimension annotations from conductors, compliance cannot be verified.
areas: All proposed site features within electric easement boundaries

flagged.comment: Proposed site features (buildings and driveways) are located in proximity to the OHE line. No survey data from a registered surveyor showing pole locations and mid-span clearances is provided.
areas: Driveways under OHE line; buildings near OHE line on south and east boundaries

areas: Decorative lighting fixtures on buildings or in common areas near OHE line
